# ACM class source

These unmodified files accompany the generated [`acmart.cls`](../../acmart.cls) used by the paper. The class and documented source identify **acmart v2.20, 2026/08/16**.

The files were recovered from the ACM template distribution retained with the manuscript's earlier source archive. The recorded upstream source is [the CTAN acmart package](https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/acmart.zip); the retrieved ZIP's SHA-256 is `93933ce58fbeffa13e23398bb523fcb68275ecc73369c6bc73b421eeef2c10de`. [UPSTREAM_NOTICE.txt](UPSTREAM_NOTICE.txt) preserves that provenance record.

[`acmart.dtx`](acmart.dtx) retains the original copyright and licence notice: copyright 2016–2026, Association for Computing Machinery; [LaTeX Project Public License](https://www.latex-project.org/lppl.txt), version 1.3 or later. Its recorded maintainer is Boris Veytsman. The generated class's notice permits redistribution with its original documented source, included here.

[`acmart.ins`](acmart.ins), the original extraction file, declares itself public domain. The separately bundled [`ACM-Reference-Format.bst`](../../ACM-Reference-Format.bst) also declares itself public domain. These third-party files retain their own terms rather than the repository's MIT licence.
